_doc: Example lines per move, de/en/es, for moves.py (bge-m3 nearest neighbours). Lines of the person practising, as people write them. 'neutral' is everything that moves nothing. Keep tests/moves_eval.py's held-out lines OUT of this file. Since 04.10.2026 also reflection, open_question, repair (lower the guard) and contempt (+2).
